description: Test suite for the frontmatter utility functions and modules used within the openclaw project. Contains unit tests for functions like normalization, parsing, and resolving of manifest fields, as well as applying common fields to install configurations.

methods.name: normalizeStringList
methods.description: Normalizes input value into a list of strings, splitting by commas if input is a string, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: getFrontmatterString
methods.description: Extracts string value of a specified key from an object if it's a string.

methods.name: parseFrontmatterBool
methods.description: Parses boolean values from strings with fallback options.

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestBlock
methods.description: Reads specific manifest keys or custom metadata fields, parsing JSON content.

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestRequires
methods.description: Normalizes requirement lists like binaries, environment variables, and configurations.

methods.name: parseOpenClawManifestInstallBase
methods.description: Parses and handles base install configuration, including type, id, label, and bins.

methods.name: applyOpenClawManifestInstallCommonFields
methods.description: Applies common fields to an install configuration object, overriding specified fields.

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestInstall
methods.description: Maps entries in install array through a parser and filters rejected specs.
